pairs.registryProposal: speech-ready-text does not say whether a test harness's synthetic speaker (LLM persona to local TTS, used to measure ASR) owes the markup door. Its 'When not to apply' covers authored scripts and short confirmations, not measurement rigs, where a voiced markup token corrupts the metric rather than a user's experience. A one-line scope note would settle it.
